fandoms: 名探偵コナン | Detective Conan | Case Closed

relationships: Kudou Shinichi | Edogawa Conan/Kuroba Kaito | Kaitou Kid

summary:
It’s the eight-year anniversary of the Tokyo Tower bombing, and a copycat has been sending anonymous countdown letters to the Tokyo Metropolitan Police. Kudou Shinichi, now a police detective under the Criminal Investigation Bureau, has enough suspicions about a possible bomb threat at one of the biggest events in Tokyo’s history. He can't afford any distractions -- he has a criminal to catch and a case to solve.
Now, if only a suspiciously familiar blackjack dealer would stop flirting with him…
